resolved_config.engine: pglite-in-memory, one brain per (document, arm) child process
resolved_config.caller: operation handlers with OperationContext { remote: false, sourceId: default }
resolved_config.search: search op (keyword), limit 10; a hit is a result whose stored chunk (content_chunks.chunk_text by chunk_id) holds the needle answer as a whole token, passage at most 65536 bytes
resolved_config.egress: largest JSON-RPC text frame of every operation result; cap 1048576 bytes
resolved_config.reads: single-page and managed-parts: get_page {slug} of the hit page; native: get_page {slug, body: window, around_chunk_id}; plus one default get_page of the entry page per arm
resolved_config.append: single-page: put_page whole page + 1 KB; managed-parts: put_page new part + hub index; native: append_page when it exists (the source's trailing whitespace, then the 1 KB day, separator none; Amendment 5)
resolved_config.native_write: native: put_page up to 4 MiB; above it an upload session (begin_page_upload mode create, upload_page_part cut to part_max_frame_bytes, commit_page_upload) when gbrain has one; the lifecycle fence write uses mode replace (Amendment 5)
resolved_config.append_cost: embedding inputs and estimated tokens (UTF-8 bytes / 4) sent by runEmbedCore({stale: true}) after the append, counted by a fake embed transport; ratio = embed tokens / appended tokens; null when the page has no chunks
resolved_config.settle_bound: write_pending polls and projection settles wait up to max(240 s, 3 s per MB of the document) (Amendment 4)
resolved_config.lifecycle: exploratory (Amendment 4): after the round trip, append a one-row facts fence and forget_fact it (fact withdrawn, recall, exported row), delete_page (search hits for one needle per decile, get_page), restore_page (hits, export equal to the pre-delete export), delete_page purge: true (residue rows and needle bytes, then sweepSegments({ graceMs: 0 })); lifecycle calls are outside the egress count
resolved_config.roundtrip: export (runExport --slug-prefix) then reassemble the body; sha256 against source body + append
